_doc: Config for the Sell Your Records page (/sell/). postage: the shipping sentence on the page (null shows 'We'll sort out shipping together when we make an offer'). Edwin covers shipping (2026-10-21): a prepaid label. local_pickup: null or false hides the pickup line and the drop-off choice in the form; true shows 'Local pickup or drop-off around Lynn and the North Shore can be arranged by appointment'. Edit and run scripts/mec build. Never imply a storefront or opening hours. Never put offer amounts or how offers are calculated here: those are private (data/sell/offer_rules.json, admin only).
postage: We cover shipping. If you're shipping, we'll send you a prepaid label.
